doc.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Cincinnati bands, race and the road to college
title: Wilberforce versus Central State and Brower's father
summary: Foster entered the state side of Wilberforce in 1946-47 as the school split; the two compare family links to Wilberforce.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How quickly coming out of this are you at Wilberforce? Or is this -- did you go Wilberforce or Central -- ? You went to Central State and Wilberforce? Did you go state side or church side?
I went state side. It was all Wilberforce University. The split came in my freshman year.
I’m certain he knew a gentleman by the name of Jimmy Guy who was a trombone player who had been a member of the Wilberforce Collegians. What was your dad’s name?
William A. Brower, Sr. He’s from High Point [North Carolina]. Same street as Trane [John Coltrane], which is another thing.
Is that right? Wow, yeah, okay. That gives you have a little bragging rights there.
I brag about having the same birthday as Trane. Where were we?
